definitions.gloss: intolerable; too much to overlook; beyond what can be ignored
definitions.explanation: Of behavior: so bad or excessive that it can no longer be quietly put up with.

examples.english: His attitude is more than I can overlook.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{目|め}に{余|あま}るようになってきた。
examples.english: His lateness has recently got out of hand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦マナー→マナー：11139_manaa⟧⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{目|め}に{余|あま}る⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ルール→ルール：00354_ruuru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Tourists' bad manners had become intolerable, so the city made new rules.

notes:
USAGE:
Used by someone in a position to judge or correct (a teacher, a manager, a city) about another's conduct, usually just before stepping in. Common forms: {目|め}に{余|あま}る⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧ / ⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ / ⟦{言動|げんどう}→言動：14147_gendou⟧, and 〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{目|め}に{余|あま}る.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見|み}かねる: unable to stand by and watch (often leading to helping).
- ⟦{我慢|がまん}できない→我慢する：25343_gamansuru⟧: cannot stand it (everyday, about one's own patience).
